name: Albric van Lahlen
description: A long-time, mid-level member of the [[Order of the White Raven]]: a churchman and graveyard digger, sent to the Dells to subvert Engineer rare-materials extraction in the dunes. After seeing [[Candure Lallensprit|Candure]] perform magic in [[place/godrastan|Godrastan]], he recruited her and [[Eivlyn Lallensprit|her brother]], saving them from discovery under its strict naturalist laws.
bond: You found a wounded beast in the forest but chose to ignore it. You see it everywhere now, but only when you're alone. It looks sad but not angry. You cannot become panicked when acting alone.

name: Candure Lallensprit
description: A half witch of Godrastan, recruited by Albric after he saw her perform magic. She knows a Fae creature's True Name from the Unseelie court: it will summon its owner for one act of great service, or fetch a hefty price from the right buyer.
bond: You carry a hand-drawn Portrait (petty) of a past love who disappeared into the Wood long ago. Somehow you know that they are still alive.
omen: The moon turns a deep crimson, bathing the night in an eerie, blood-red light. Some say it heralds a time of chaos and strife, as the boundaries between the Wood and the mortal realm grow thin.

name: Eivlyn Lallensprit
description: A prowler of Godrastan, [[Candure Lallensprit|Candure]]'s brother. HP noted as 2 [+2].
bond: During your travels, you met a dying hunter who asked you to deliver a message to their loved ones. Take a Letter (petty), sealed with tree sap. It is addressed only to the Lord of Winter.
